values.meaning: Recast time limit (buff duration to swap)
values.quote: gains a buff for {{fd|5.25}} seconds that indicates and determines the duration in which he may recast ''Living Shadow''

mechanics.claim: Zed and his Shadows mimic Q and E; hitting an ability on the same target from both restores energy, once per cast ability.
mechanics.quote: restores {{sti|{{as|energy}}}} whenever he and his [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' or multiple ''Shadows'' hit an ability on the same target. This may only occur once per cast ability.

mechanics.claim: The energy refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: The {{sti|energy}} refund is not granted if the mimicked ability is blocked by a {{tip|spell shield}}.

mechanics.claim: The Shadow can mimic Razor Shuriken and Shadow Slash regardless of range.
mechanics.quote: being able to mimic ''{{ai|Razor Shuriken|Zed}}'' and ''{{ai|Shadow Slash|Zed}}'' regardless of range

mechanics.claim: If cast while Q is in cast time and recast swaps places, Zed releases the shuriken from the original cast location while remaining in cast time, then throws the shuriken the Shadow would have thrown from the new location.
mechanics.quote: If ''Living Shadow'' is recast during {{ais|Q|Zed}} cast, '''Zed''' will instantly release the shuriken from the cast location of {{ai|Q|Zed}} while still remaining in cast time. Once he has swapped places, he will then throw the shuriken that the [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' would have thrown instead.

mechanics.claim: Casting a new Living Shadow while a non-Death Mark Shadow already exists makes the previous Shadow instantly disappear.
mechanics.quote: If '''Zed''' casts ''Living Shadow'' while a non-''{{ai|Death Mark 2|Zed|Death Mark}} Shadow'' is already present, the previous ''Shadow'' will instantly disappear.

mechanics.claim: If the Shadow expires during Q's cast time, the mimicked cast is cancelled.
mechanics.quote: If a [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadow'' expires while in the cast time of {{ai|Q|Zed}}, the mimicked cast will be cancelled.

mechanics.claim: Shadows cast E independently of whether Zed is in Q's cast time.
mechanics.quote: [[File:Zed's Shadow.png|20px|border|link=]] ''Shadows'' will cast {{ai|E|Zed}} independently of being in {{ais|Q|Zed}} cast time or not.
